description: Two independently assembled walkable houses; identical first-attempt Tripo and Meshy component requests. Original early-floor low-fantasy workshop-home, not an exact canonical SAO location.
style: Single isolated game prop, complete on every side. Hand-painted anime low-fantasy European town style: honey oak, pale stone, muted iron, restrained teal accents, clean broad colors and soft wear. No characters, writing, logos, scenery, display pedestal or baked shadows. No modern technology or magical glow.

assets.prompt: One rectangular upright oak door leaf only, straight flat top, vertical planks, two iron hinge straps on the left and one iron ring handle on the right. Flat thin back. No frame, arch, wall, threshold or scenery. Intended 2.25m tall, 1.25m wide, 0.10m thick.

One upright rectangular teal-painted wooden window shutter leaf only, opaque vertical boards with two honey-oak horizontal braces, two small iron hinges on its left edge. Flat thin back. No glass, window frame, wall or other shutter. Intended 1.2m tall, 0.6m wide, 0.06m thick.

One beginner one-handed arming sword, straight modest steel double-edged blade, plain crossguard, brown leather grip and small round pommel. Practical ordinary equipment, not a legendary weapon. No scabbard, stand or other objects. Intended overall length 1.0m.

One practical round wooden shield, visible oak boards, dull iron rim and central steel boss, brown leather arm straps on the back. Restrained teal stripe, no emblem. No stand. Intended diameter 0.65m.

One empty freestanding honey-oak weapon rack for three swords, two vertical posts, an upper rail with wide open slots and a lower shelf, sturdy feet. No weapons or shield included. Intended height 1.5m and width 1.3m.

One empty sturdy wooden craftsman's workbench with a thick rectangular honey-oak top, four legs, lower shelf and one small iron vise at the left end. No tools or other props on the top. Intended width 1.8m, depth 0.7m, height 0.9m.

One compact dark iron blacksmith anvil on a short round wooden stump, plain horn and broad flat working surface. Anvil and stump together are one equipment item. No hammer, tools, debris or scenery. Intended total height 0.85m.

One freestanding pale-stone cooking hearth with an open dark firebox, iron grate, broad cooking ledge and short hood chimney. Empty firebox, no smoke, flame, pot, wall or floor. Complete back. Intended width 1.35m and height 1.9m.

One simple single honey-oak bed with four legs, modest headboard, straw mattress, cream pillow and a muted teal wool blanket. Plain linen bedding, no canopy or bedside objects. Intended length 2.1m, width 1.05m.
One closed modest rectangular oak storage chest, flat hinged lid, iron corner bands and simple front latch. No coins, ornament, pedestal or surrounding objects. Intended width 1.0m and height 0.55m.

One empty small rectangular honey-oak dining table with four legs, plain joined plank top and sturdy crossbraces. No chairs, cloth, utensils or food. Intended width 1.35m, depth 0.8m and height 0.76m.
One simple honey-oak dining chair, four legs, flat wooden seat, open slatted back and no armrests or upholstery. No surrounding objects. Intended total height 0.95m, seat height 0.45m.
One empty freestanding narrow honey-oak shelving unit, four open shelves, solid side posts and back crossbraces. No books, jars or objects on shelves. Intended height 1.8m, width 1.05m, depth 0.35m.

One small squat green-blue glass restorative potion bottle with a cork stopper and a plain leather neck tie. Visible blue liquid, opaque stylized glass acceptable. No glowing effects, writing, label, stand or other objects. Intended height 0.18m.

One compact rectangular dark iron lantern with four clear yellowish glass sides, an unlit candle inside and a simple top carrying ring. Flat base, no hook, stand, wall or flame effects. Intended height 0.35m.
One empty open round cast-iron cooking pot, two short side handles, a round thick rim and three very short feet. No lid, fire, food, stand or other objects. Intended diameter 0.4m.

One simple meal item: a shallow wooden plate holding one small rustic bread loaf and two pale cheese wedges. Compact arrangement, no table, cutlery, cloth, drink or background objects. Intended plate diameter 0.3m.

One simple warm cream ceramic water jug, rounded body, short pouring lip, one curved handle and a small muted teal band. Empty open mouth. No stopper, cup, table, decoration or other objects. Intended height 0.3m.

canon_scope: Early Aincrad town, simple sword equipment, low-fantasy lodging and trade. House layout and individual props are original project design, not asserted to be exact novel canon or an official licensed SAO product.
